concept: Хоррор-кино, мило и смешно: классические монстры и атрибуты Хэллоуина — сладости, шляпа ведьмы, гроб вампира, тыква, привидение, кот, лаборатория Франкенштейна, рука зомби, дом с привидениями, оборотень и луна.
style_mood: Mood: a cozy, funny Halloween family movie: playful and a little spooky, never truly scary; soft rounded shapes, warm glowing lights, a friendly carved face on the pumpkin; no skulls, no bones, no blood, no fangs, no scary monsters.
palette_note: Spooky: фиолетовый, оранжевый, мятно-зелёный; ночь яркая, «конфетная»; три ночные сцены разведены по оттенкам (оранжевые сумерки, синяя ночь, малиновая ночь).

cards.label: Old Grave
cards.object: old crooked tombstone on a small grassy mound
cards.object_color: soft lilac stone with a little green moss
cards.scene: crooked tombstone on a grassy mound
cards.key_features: ONE rounded tombstone leaning strongly to the side, a single crack and a small patch of moss on top, a simple carved crescent moon instead of any letters; clean and simple: NO bat, NO fence, NO leaves, NO cobweb, NO pumpkin, no other objects; funny-neglected, not scary
cards.pose: 3/4 view at eye level, the tombstone leaning to the right on its little mound, centered

cards.label: Witch Hat
cards.story_detail: a wide band with a square buckle
cards.detail_color: bright orange with a gold buckle
cards.key_features: a tall pointed crown with a soft bent tip, a wide floppy brim, an orange band with a buckle
cards.pose: The hat is tilted diagonally, the bent tip pointing to the upper right

cards.label: Coffin
cards.object: cute cartoon coffin standing upright with its lid half open
cards.object_color: plum purple wood with gold handles
cards.scene: coffin standing on a plain floor
cards.story_detail: a plush red velvet pillow and a folded vampire cape with a red lining inside
cards.key_features: a classic six-sided coffin shape, rounded and toy-like, lid swung half open showing the cozy inside, small golden handles; cute and funny, not scary
cards.pose: 3/4 view at eye level, the lid opened to the right

cards.label: Jack-o'-Lantern
cards.scene: glowing pumpkin on a porch step
cards.story_detail: a warm candle glow shining through its carved face
cards.key_features: a round ribbed pumpkin with a green curly stem and a friendly carved smiling face with triangle eyes, glowing from inside
cards.pose: 3/4 view at eye level, the smiling face toward the viewer

cards.label: Boo!
cards.background_pattern: faint repeating pattern of small bat icons
cards.key_features: a simple draped white bedsheet ghost with a wavy hem, two dark oval eye holes and a small round 'oo' mouth, a mischievous playful look; NOT a baby face: no cheeks, no blush, no big cartoon eyes with highlights, no tiny arms
cards.pose: The ghost floats slightly tilted, the sheet billowing, the hem flowing to the lower left

cards.label: Spooky Cat
cards.object: hairless sphynx cat with an arched back
cards.object_color: very dark charcoal-black with a soft plum-purple sheen
cards.scene: cat standing on a plain floor
cards.key_features: a sleek hairless sphynx cat with smooth wrinkled skin, big ears, a strongly arched back, a very long thin tail curling up, big round golden-yellow eyes; dark but with clear soft highlights so the form reads; funny and startled, not scary
cards.pose: side 3/4 view at eye level, back arched high, the long tail curving up into an S shape

cards.label: Mad Lab
cards.background_color: deep navy blue at the top fading to light sky blue
cards.scene: a simple mad scientist experiment on a pale stone table
cards.story_detail: a round flask of bubbling glowing lime-green potion
cards.key_features: only three elements on one small rounded brass base: a round glass plasma ball with a little pink-blue lightning inside (center), one round flask of lime-green potion (left), a big brass knife-switch lever with a red knob (right); no pipes, no tubes, no coils, no extra knobs or gauges; clean smooth brass with soft even shading; playful, cartoonish
cards.pose: 3/4 view at eye level, the plasma ball in the center, the flask on the left, the lever on the right

cards.label: Zombie Hand
cards.object: zombie hand bursting out of the desert sand
cards.object_color: sickly mint green with a stitched patch
cards.scene: a warm orange sandy desert with soft dunes and a couple of small cacti under a bright violet-orange twilight sky with a pale moon
cards.key_features: a single cartoon zombie hand and forearm reaching up out of the sand with spread, slightly bent fingers and short claw-like nails, a torn ragged sleeve cuff and a stitched patch, sand spilling off it; funny but a little spooky, no bones, no blood; nothing in the hand
cards.pose: Low camera close to the sand, the hand big in the center foreground reaching up toward the sky, a little sand spray around the wrist

cards.label: Haunted House
cards.scene: a simple smooth green hill under a bright saturated blue night sky with one small pale muted moon; bright saturated night scene, not gloomy
cards.key_features: a SIMPLE silhouette: one main crooked two-story body with a single tall pointy teal turret on one side, a simple steep teal roof, only 3-4 glowing yellow windows and one front door; few segments, no extra wings, no balconies, no shutters clutter; only the house, the simple hill and the sky — no fence, no path, no pumpkin, no ghost, no trees; cute and whimsical, not scary
cards.pose: 3/4 view from slightly below, the house centered on top of the simple green hill which is clearly visible at the bottom, sky around it, a small pale moon to one side

cards.label: Howl!
cards.object: wolf howling at the full moon on a rocky hilltop
cards.object_color: deep indigo-navy fur with soft lavender rim highlights
cards.scene: a simple rocky hilltop with one bare twisted tree under a bright violet-magenta night sky with a huge glowing full moon; bright saturated night scene, not gloomy; no pumpkins, no other objects
cards.key_features: a fluffy cartoon wolf sitting on a rock, head raised and muzzle up howling at the moon; its fur is a deep dark indigo-navy that clearly stands out against the bright moon, but not a flat black silhouette: soft rim light and visible fur volume; cute and funny, not scary, no fangs
cards.pose: The wolf is medium-sized and sits in the lower middle of the frame, the WHOLE round moon fully visible behind and above it with plenty of sky around; the wolf does not fill the frame
